description: Disconnect one connected account. Destructive and not undoable: disconnecting a HubSpot portal also deletes every record it synced. Never call this to check anything; call list_integrations for that. Only call it when the user has asked to disconnect, in their own words, naming what.

account.description: Which account, by the exact label list_integrations reported. Required when more than one is connected.

name: disconnect_integration
title: Disconnect an account
